find_instance_center: find instance center points from a center heatmap using thresholding and NMS
group_pixels: assign each pixel an instance id by computing nearest center point distance
get_instance_segmentation: compute class agnostic instance segmentation from semantic labels, center heatmap, and offsets
merge_semantic_and_instance: merge semantic segmentation labels with instance segmentation to produce panoptic segmentation
get_panoptic_segmentation: run full panoptic segmentation post-processing from semantic labels, center heatmap, and offsets
